newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Rubber futures ended narrowly in moderate trade on Tuesday on late sporadic buying and selling interest, amid uncertainty over market direction, brokers said.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were also narrowly mixed as individual investors hunted for bargains amid expectations of amply supply in the short term and the yen's rise against the U.S. dollar.

"The market was untraded in the morning on a lack of fresh incentives but some speculative buying and selling interest emerged in the afternoon amid uncertainty over market direction," a local dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, March RSS3 eased 0.75 cent to 120.00 U.S. cents a kg.
April RSS1 rose 1.25 cents to 173.00 Singapore cents (US$1.22) a kg.
April TSR20 rose 0.75 cent to 168.75 Singapore cents (US$1.19) a kg.
